metadata.methods_description: Participants performed a sound localization task while exposed to a fear conditioning paradigm with Pre-Conditioning, Conditioning, and Extinction phases. Voice stimuli varying in amplitude modulation (highAM/lowAM) were either paired (CS+) or unpaired (CS-) with an aversive loud white noise (US), using 50% partial reinforcement. Stimulus-US pairing was counterbalanced by voice gender across participants. EEG, pupillometry, and behavioral (contingency, valence, arousal, response time, hit rate) data were recorded concurrently. Four of 32 participants were excluded due to low EEG signal-to-noise ratio, leaving a final sample of 28 (12 female, ages 18-31).
